item.stem_gist: Primary adrenal insufficiency: presentation, diagnosis, and replacement therapy.

correct_pearl: Primary adrenal insufficiency requires both glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid replacement.

high_yield.text: low cortisol with elevated ACTH; ACTH stimulation test
unlike secondary adrenal insufficiency: mineralocorticoid replacement required

cards.text: {{c1::Primary adrenal insufficiency}} in adults is most often caused by autoimmune adrenal destruction.
{{c1::Elevated ACTH}} with low cortisol supports primary adrenal insufficiency.
cards.extra: Unlike secondary disease, mineralocorticoid replacement is required.
